queries_run: Cencora fiscal 2026 fourth quarter results U.S. Healthcare Solutions International Healthcare Solutions revenue growth
Cencora fiscal 2027 guidance outlook GLP-1 specialty demand

findings.claim: FY26 Q4 營收 $88.4B、年增約5.5%；U.S. Healthcare Solutions 營收 $78.3B、年增5.4%；OneOncology（2026-02收購）提升該段毛利率，GLP-1 銷售增加（毛利較低）部分抵銷。
findings.source: Cencora FY2026 Q4 8-K Exhibit 99.1 / 新聞稿 (2026-11-04)

findings.claim: FY27 指引：營收成長3–5%、調整後營業利益成長4–6%、調整後EPS $19.40–$19.75（+8–10%）；因出售（divestiture）稀釋，標題指引低於市場預期（二手來源）。
findings.source: finviz: Cencora closes FY26 above raised guidance but a divestiture diluted FY27 outlook resets expectations lower

findings.claim: Specialty 段 FY27 營收成長 9–14%、營業利益成長 18–21%；PDS 營業利益成長 2–4%
findings.source: Finchannel: Cencora earnings rise as specialty growth reshapes 2027 outlook
findings.excerpt: Cencora expects specialty-segment revenue growth of 9%–14% and operating-income growth of 18%–21%. Those forecasts include the continuing contribution from OneOncology, acquired in February 2026.

end_markets.note: International Q4 成長率與 specialty 段 FY27 指引（9–14%營收、18–21%營業利益，僅單一二手來源）未核實；MDS TAM 共識、市佔/定價未搜尋到來源。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
